caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet composed of two prominent colors: red and gray. The front and sides of the bonnet are covered in red fabric, including a gathered or pleated band framing the face, a bow or decorative accent on top, and two long red ribbons extending downward from either side, meant for tying under the chin. The back portion of the bonnet is shaded in gray, indicating a softer, gathered fabric that covers the back of the head. The interior lining of the bonnet, visible at the front opening, appears to be a pale pinkish color. On the lower right corner of the image, there is a smaller, simple line drawing showing the back view of the bonnet, labeled “Back View” with the name “Mary Humes” written underneath. The background of the image is plain and uncolored.
title: Bonnet
